name: Qutb ud-Din Aibak
role: Ghurid general and Sultan of Delhi from 1206 to 1210
contribution: A Turkic general of the Ghurid emperor Muhammad Ghori.

checks.lead: Qutb ud-Din Aibak (Persian: قطب‌الدین ایبک; 1150 – 4 November 1210) was a Turkic general of the Ghurid emperor Muhammad Ghori. He was in charge of the Ghurid territories in northern India, and after Muhammad Ghori's assassination in 1206, he established his own independent rule in Lahore, laying the foundations for the Sultanate of Delhi.
